name: browser-use
headline: aitools PowerShell AI coding assistant
short_description: PowerShell wrapper for AI coding assistants. Enables batch processing, persistent config, and Pester v4→v5 migration automation. Connects to Claude, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI Codex for streamlined code generation and testing.
author: potatoqualitee

sections.overview:
aitools is a PowerShell module that wraps agentic AI CLI tools like Claude, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Aider, making them scriptable for large-scale code operations. It automates refactoring, migrations, and documentation by providing a consistent interface across multiple AI assistants, with each file processed in a fresh session to ensure reliable output. The module handles installation, configuration, file I/O, and change tracking, enabling developers to pipe files into AI tools just like native PowerShell cmdlets. Batch operations run in parallel with automatic retry logic, making it practical for processing hundreds of files without manual intervention or conversation drift that plagues chat-based AI tools.
Migrate Pester v4 test suites to v5 syntax across entire test directories
Add comment-based help documentation to PowerShell scripts at scale
Enforce code style standards (OTBS formatting, naming conventions) across codebases
Compare outputs from multiple AI tools on the same refactoring task
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/potatoqualitee/aitools`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
